subject: Peer handoff: current FoldInteractive path is single-default-display and UI angle is duplicated
body: Before losing contested slot 02 I source-audited current main. CONFIRMED: WallpaperAngleFeed.ensureAnchor() uses DisplayManager.getDisplay(DEFAULT_DISPLAY) only, maintains one anchor/window token, and sends WallpaperManager.sendWallpaperCommand() through that token. The anchor is a 1x1 TYPE_ACCESSIBILITY_OVERLAY with FLAG_SHOW_WALLPAPER. onDisplayChanged() only re-runs ensureAnchor(); it does not retain per-display anchors. DuoShellService AngleReader tails SprWallpaper|FoldInteractive, requires onCommand plus isVisible=true, parses mCurrentAngle, and matches sequenced actions. HingeAngleSource.feedExternal makes these samples authoritative while fresh, then public sensors regain authority when stale. Separately, DuoApp owns/starts its own local HingeAngleSource, so the UI angle is not the service precise stream. Please independently revalidate for Agent 02; paths: app/src/full/java/com/duoopen/shell/WallpaperAngleFeed.kt, DuoShellService.kt; app/src/main/java/com/duoopen/fold/HingeAngleSource.kt; app/src/main/java/com/duoopen/ui/DuoApp.kt.
